title: ha/dr: automate multi-AZ failover, restore drills, and runbooks-as-code for private installer (helm + terraform + upgrade tooling)
author: Sofia Ramirez
release_notes: Added automation for multi-AZ failover and restore drills; Helm chart updates for canary and anti-affinity; Terraform modules support cross-AZ provisioning; runbooks-as-code under /runbooks and upgrade/rollback tooling for safe private installer upgrades.
description: Motivation: customers running Redwood Private in regulated environments need predictable HA and tested DR runbooks. This PR automates multi-AZ provisioning, failover, and restore drills for the private-installer path (VPC + on-prem helper), and adds runbooks-as-code so drills are repeatable and reviewable. Summary of changes: 1) Terraform: new az-aware modules + example for multi-AZ VPC networking and subnet layout; 2) Helm charts: anti-affinity defaults, canary values and probe tuning, preStop hooks for graceful KV cache flush; 3) Upgrade/rollback tooling: safe rollout script that coordinates Helm rollouts across AZs and runs preflight checks; 4) Runbooks-as-code: /runbooks/ha-dr/private-installer with step-by-step drill playbooks and automated verification scripts; 5) CI: terraform plan and helm-lint integration plus an integration test that runs a simulated failover on a small cluster. Checklist: - [x] Terraform modules implemented and tested in staging - [x] Helm changes linted and smoke-tested - [x] Runbooks added and reviewed by SRE - [x] Integration test added to pipeline - [x] Documentation updated (docs/ha-dr.md). Notes: this PR is additive and backwards-compatible with existing single-AZ installs; however recommended values change when running multi-AZ (see release_notes).

merge_commit_message: Squash: ha/dr automation: multi-AZ terraform module, Helm updates, upgrade/rollback coordinator, runbooks-as-code
notes_on_upgrade_rollback: Added bin/upgrade-rollback-coordinator.sh which sequences Helm canary releases across AZs, validates post-deploy metrics (latency/error thresholds), and triggers rollback if thresholds exceeded. Coordinator supports a dry-run mode and a skip-az argument for partial upgrades. Rollback logic uses Helm rollback + restoration of KV cache from S3 snapshot when available.
impact_summary: Enables customers to run automated failover drills and safer upgrades for private installer in multi-AZ deployments. Reduced manual steps for DR testing and consistent, auditable runbooks-as-code. No breaking changes for single-AZ installs; recommended default values updated for multi-AZ.
